import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static List<List<List<Integer>>> pref = new ArrayList<>();

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        int res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static List<List<Integer>> mat_mult(List<List<Integer>> A, List<List<Integer>> B) {
        int size = k + 1;
        List<List<Integer>> C = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            C.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                    int val = add_mod(C.get(i).get(t), mul_mod(A.get(i).get(j), B.get(j).get(t)));
                    C.get(i).set(t, val);
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static List<List<List<Integer>>> shift_matrix(List<List<Integer>> M) {
        int size = k + 1;
        List<List<List<Integer>>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int s = 0; s <= k; s++) {
            res.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                res.get(s).add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = i;
                if (ni < k) ni = (ni + k - 1) % k;
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < k) nj = (nj + k - 1) % k;
                res.get(i).set(j, M.get(ni).get(nj));
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void prepare() {
        long temp = n;
        int digits = 0;
        while (temp > 0) {
            temp /= k;
            digits++;
        }
        pref.clear();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> basePref = new ArrayList<>();
        basePref.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            basePref.get(0).add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            basePref.get(0).get(i).set(i, 1);
        }
        basePref.get(0).get(0).set(k, 1);
        basePref.get(0).get(k).set(0, (int)(MOD - 1));
        basePref.get(0).get(k).set(k, 2);
        pref.add(basePref);

        for (int s = 0; s < digits; s++) {
            List<List<List<Integer>>> currentPref = pref.get(s);
            List<List<List<Integer>>> nextPref = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                nextPref.add(new ArrayList<>());
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    nextPref.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                        nextPref.get(i).set(t, add_mod(nextPref.get(i).get(t), mul_mod(currentPref.get(i).get(j), currentPref.get(j).get(t))));
                    }
                }
            }
            pref.add(nextPref);
        }
    }

    static List<List<Integer>> get_result(long n_value) {
        int size = k + 1;
        if (n_value == 0) {
            List<List<Integer>> c = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
                c.get(i).set(i, 1);
            }
            return c;
        }
        long pw = 1;
        int d = 0;
        while (pw <= n_value / k) {
            pw *= k;
            d++;
        }
        if (n_value == pw) {
            return pref.get(d);
        }
        long steps = n_value / pw;
        long rem = n_value - steps * pw;
        List<List<List<Integer>>> matrix_curr = prepare();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> coef = pref.get(d);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            matrix_curr = mat_mult(matrix_curr, coef);
            coef = shift_matrix(coef);
        }
        List<List<List<Integer>>> remaining = prepare();
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            remaining = shift_matrix(remaining);
        }
        return mat_mult(matrix_curr, remaining);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        prepare();
        List<List<Integer>> answer = get_result(n);
        System.out.println(answer.get(k).get(k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
